verdict.rationale: The official vuejs/core GitHub repository directs users to an official community chat at chat.vuejs.org for questions and support, alongside the official forum. That covers both getting help and connecting with other Vue users. However, the evidence is a single README line. Missing for 10: details on the chat platform and its channels, first-party docs describing the community space, and independent or hands-on evidence that the chat is active and helpful.
